regions.name: Naraka
regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own painting of Naraka, restored from its 2012 Encyclopedia map, which drew no roads, names or buttons on this region. An image model sharpened it without moving anything, then it was toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: 2012 had no markings; the restore only adds detail at 2x. The spiral path round the pit, the stone face on its lower ledge, every dead tree on the ledges, the grey stone between the top trees, the red glow and its rays in the pit, the stalactites, the red columns and the grey pillars at the left sit where 2012 had them (worst tile drift 4 px at 2x in the dark top-left and lower tiles; the rest 0 to 1 px). The sharpening drew a dark bare trunk at the top of the path as a branched dead tree like its neighbours. Returned slightly lighter than 2012 (mean mid lightness 0.245 against 0.221); the toning matched its saturation and, using gamma only, does not darken (gamma 1.0).
